title: Engenheiro De Integração De Dados Sênior (Ae)
description:
Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (DE)


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

- Estruturar e manter os processos de ingestão de dados de múltiplos serviços, sistemas e fontes externas da plataforma, focando em alta performance e qualidade dos dados;

- Entender profundamente a plataforma técnica para identificar novas fontes e evoluções necessárias, com suporte do time de tecnologia;

- Você será a “Força” do time de Engenharia de Dados dentro dos squads de tecnologia e deve ser capaz de entregar de ponta a ponta as demandas específicas, alinhando processos, dependências e suporte com o time do CoE de Dados;

- Criação e sustentação de pipelines de integração dos dados do ambiente de produção por CDC;

- Otimização do processamento dos dados para alta disponibilidade;

- Soluções de integração de dados externos (parceiros e outros sistemas), via API, FTP ou consumo direto de flat files;

- Orquestração detodas as dependências (pré e pós) e garantida de entrega;

- Mapeamento de evolução da plataforma de dados e adequação a novas implementações técnicas;

- Manutenção de Estruturas de Dados para consumo específico, como Data Marts e Feature Stores;

- Implementação das regras globais de arquitetura e governança de dados.


O que você precisa ter

- Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;

- Cloud Computing| Azure, AWS, GCP;

- Workflow | Control-M e/ou AirFlow;

- Storage Solutions | Redshift, Parquet, Delta;

- Estatística | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, testes de hipótese, regressão;

- Data Modeling |Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;

- Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;

- SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;

- Dremio, Looker,Metabase ou outras plataformas de Self-Service de dados | Para se colocar sempre no lugar do cliente;

- Python ou R | Para quando a coisa fica bem séria;

- Scala & Spark |Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;

- Inglês e/ou Espanhol intermediário ou superior – Obrigatório.


Será um diferencial seu perfil com:

- Ter instalado ferramentas de integração de dados (on premisses ou cloud);

- Atuado na administração de ferramentas (on premisses ou cloud);

- Capacidade parafazer troubleshooting em erros de conexão/conectividade;

- Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;

- Aplicação de TOGAF, DAMA ou frameworks de arquitetura similares;

- Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;

- Compreensão dosdiferentes tipos de protocolo HTTP, AMQP, TCP, TLS;

- Conhecimento e utilização de ferramentas para APM, Observabilidade, Monitoria e Logging (ex.: NewRelic, Dynatrace, Datadog, ELK, etc.);

- Experiência no trabalho com Containers, em especial, Kubernetes.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

  • Ensino médio completo;

  • Experiência comvenda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;

title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences;
    to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.
Core Competencies
  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors;
    partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner;
    reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity;
    cares holistically for those served;
    maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered;
    treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.
Minimum Requirements
  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.
  • Four (4) years of responsible work experience in psychiatry.
  • A great bedside manner and the ability to remain calm, empathetic and patient while interacting with patients who suffer from severe mental disorders.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork.

We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

As a Legal Secretary you will be responsible for supporting all AME Geo Legal commercial and administrative activity in the AME Geo, with a focus on reviewing customer RFPs, supplier agreements, and general commercial documents and deals arising in the SITA at Airports, Communications & Data Exchange products and Borders business units.

You will be a part of the overall SITA Global Legal Team of 40+ lawyers and professionals around the globe, which includes Geography-based legal teams in Singapore, Europe and Beirut, specialists/teams in M&A, Corporate Legal, Data, IPR, Sanctions, Ethics, Regulatory.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Assist AME Geo Legal attorneys in preparing, revising and organizing legal documents, including RFPs, contracts, reports, case files.
  • Conduct legal research and gather relevant information to support case preparation and strategy.
  • Manage and maintain AME Geo Legal databases and document management systems.
  • Oversee the payment process of external law firms, including raising purchase orders, revising invoices, ensuring accuracy and processing payments in a timely manner.
  • Provide administrative support to the AME GEO Legal, including managing calendars, assisting with the preparation of reports and presentations for external and internal use.
  • Communicate with external legal counsels and other stakeholders across different jurisdictions, where needed.
  • Support AME Geo Legal in various projects and initiatives as needed.
  • Maintain excellent inter-personnel communications and relationships.
  • Advising internal teams on SITA policies and procedures related to commercial contracts.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven track record in multi-national environments, particularly within the North America and Latin America regions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, legal studies or a related field.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, change-oriented commercial environment and you understand financial principles and practices in a multi-national corporate context.
  • 7+ years relevant work experience to include legal document review and comment as well as negotiation skills.
  • Excellent organization and administrative skills with attention to detail.
  • Business acumen and understanding of corporate operations and governance standards.
  • Strong project management principles (task identification and prioritization, timeline management, results focus).
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess complex situations and develop appropriate strategies.
  • Excellent written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly communicate factual matters, effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Completely fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish (written and spoken);
    all other languages a real plus.

WHAT WE OFFER:

At SITA, we disrupt the status quo, by empowering our people to pioneer innovations that touch the lives of billions. Bringing together diverse minds from across the globe, we foster a dynamic and positive workplace culture, that values our talented team members for their contributions and dedication.

Our core benefits include:

  • Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on the needs of your team and your customers)
  • Flex Day: Shape your workday to suit your life and your plans.

  • Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

São mais 30 anos recheados de aprendizados e doces conquistas. A Cultura vivenciada na empresa traduz a essência de quem somos e onde queremos chegar.

Vivemos para Juntos tocar a vida das pessoas compartilhando momentos especiais.

Ingredientes como Foco, Atitude, União, Alegria e muita Paixão por realizar nos impulsiona a fazer sempre o melhor, transformando o Ordinário em Extraordinário.

A nossa turma é formada por pessoas que fazem da Cacau show um lugar especial para se trabalhar, onde todos são tratados com igualdade, independentemente de gênero, raça, idade, origem ou orientação sexual, sendo nosso processo baseado em meritocracia.

Na Cacau todos são Show!!!

Se você é apaixonado pelo que faz, possui senso de dono e muito “gás” para trabalhar, essa vaga é a sua cara!!!

Responsibilities
  • Gerenciar a equipe de vendas no atendimento aos clientes, orientando-os na execução de suas tarefas buscando o alcance das metas estabelecidas;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores diariamente, atuando para seu cumprimento;
  • Garantir o abastecimento da loja através da compra de produtos junto a franqueadora e fornecedores homologados garantindo o mix obrigatório;
  • Gerar arquivos pertinentes a notas fiscais, em sistema apropriado, providenciando o envio dos mesmos a Receita Federal, visando o cumprimento das obrigações legais;
  • Cumprir todas as obrigações fiscais exigidas pela controladoria;
  • Realizar e acompanhar (a equipe) a execução dos treinamentos EAD;
  • Gerenciar contas da loja, enviando-as para pagamento;
  • Realizar reunião semanal com a equipe, preenchendo a ata de reunião, fixando-a no quadro de Gestão a Vista;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas PEF, garantindo assim aproveitamento satisfatório no programa;
  • Realizar o inventário mensal da unidade, controlando validades evitando assim perda de produtos e margem.
Qualifications
  • Necessário ensino superior completo completo ou cursando;
  • A partir de 2 anos em cargos de gestão de equipes;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar em uma escala 6x1.

Pensar em chocolate é pensar em felicidade com sabor, não é mesmo? Aqui na Cacau Show,somos apaixonados por chocolate e por todas as experiências e memórias que ele proporciona.

Por isso, nós cuidamos com atenção de cada detalhe para oferecer aos nossos clientes os melhores produtos,atendimento personalizado, e claro, uma deliciosa experiência. E para isso acontecer, contamos com uma turma que conhece o chocolate desde a sua origem, além de toda a sua potencialidade e possibilidades.

Aqui, trabalhamos com ética, disciplina e a melhor tecnologia para sempre entregar produtos que farão parte de momentos especiais na vida de milhares de pessoas! A nossa grande paixão é transformar o ordinário em extraordinário.

Nossa cultura é repleta de elementos que traduzem toda a nossa intensidade em proporcionar os melhores momentos e oportunidades para nossa turma. Aqui nós sonhamos, planejamos, acreditamos, realizamos e estamos sempre conectados.

Ao longo da nossa jornada, construímos uma história sólida e nos tornamos líderes no segmento de chocolates finos do mundo, com mais de 3.700 lojas em todo Brasil, gerando oportunidades de emprego e buscando sempre fazer a diferença no mundo, afinal...

Vivemos para, juntos, tocar a vida das pessoas, compartilhando momentos especiais.

Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population;
employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities
  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history;
    examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images;
    analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs;
    inoculate and vaccinatepatients;
    advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities;
    refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs;
    participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required;
    work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested;
    adhere to safety and infection control policies;
    provide age-appropriatecare across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications;
    participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals;
    contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.
Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications
  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics;
    board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California;
    current DEA license;
    ACLS for FP/IM;
    PALS for Pediatrics;
    BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required;
    Spanish bilingual desirable.
Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements
  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

title: Partner Marketing Director
description:

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.G. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence;
in order to succeed, weneed to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

title: Head Of Medical Marketing And Advocacy (M/F/D)
description:
Overview

Goal of function: We are seeking a Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d) to lead and innovate Care Enablement advocacy strategies to improve external HCP stakeholder engagement and knowledge development, ultimately creating advocacy for innovative therapies. The position involves developing and organizing customized advocacy programs such as therapy educational round tables, symposia and reference center programs for targeted education and advocacy, creating opportunities to meaningfully educate and impact the practice of participants. It requires collaboration across all functions of the business units and regions (Marketing, Sales, Application, Compliance, and Medical Affairs) to develop an agile program strategy aligned with business priorities and strategic imperatives.


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation and execution of a strategic medical marketing and advocacy plan targeting external HCPs, aligned with business goals and addressing gaps, ensuring a consistent risk-based approach. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment

  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to build strong relationships with internal and external speakers to create impactful educational programs. Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. Establish and support reference centers of excellence as hubs for peer-to-peer learning and clinical demonstration

  • Oversee planning, contracting, and execution of impactful advocacy activities like commercial symposia, workshops, and conferences. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality events within medical and legal compliance frameworks

  • Lead the creation of targeted therapy content of the programs and events for diverse external audiences ensuring compliance with regulations and accreditation standards. Collaborate with KOLs on timely, creative promotion using marketing and social media platforms

  • Establish a global approval matrix for activities to ensure education programs comply with regulations and standards. Monitor and implement emerging regulatory trends

  • Lead a small team, ensure budget transparency, and foster a high-performance, collaborative culture

  • Assess educational program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement


Your Profile

  • Ideally Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Medicine. Advanced qualifications such as a PhD, Doctorate, MBA, or a marketing degree are considered a plus. Candidates with strong relevant experience may also be considered from other academic backgrounds

  • Min of 5-7 years of experience with advanced degree (alternatively min. of 10-15 years of experience with Master’s degree) in medical marketing, HCP education, or advocacy development within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry

  • Fluent in English, additional language skills (e.G., Dutch, German, Spanish) are a plus

  • Proven track record of building and managing KOL networks and educational initiatives

  • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks in medical communications

  • Leads with vision and impact, demonstrating excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills while navigating complexity, ensuring accountability, and driving continuous improvement to achieve strategic goals

  • Willingness to travel regionally/nationally as needed


Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter on which field you are an expert (m/f/d) and how much experience you have - for your professional career.


A Future with meaning:



  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world

  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development

  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one

  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience

  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

description:
Intercâmbio Profissional – Digital Marketing Executive | Cairo, Egito

Intercâmbio Profissional – Digital Marketing Executive | KHEBRAT MISR (Cairo, Egito)

Quer dar um passo decisivo na sua carreira e vivenciar o marketing digital em um contexto internacional?

Com o programa Talento Global da AIESEC , você poderá aplicar seus conhecimentos na prática, desenvolvendo-se profissionalmente enquanto mergulha em uma cultura diversa e amplia sua visão de mundo.

A KHEBRAT MISR , empresa egípcia especializada na comercialização de licenças de software e soluções tecnológicas, busca um(a) Digital Marketing Executive para integrar sua equipe em Cairo, Egito .

Você será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar campanhas de marketing digital em diversos canais, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento e fortalecimento da marca.

Local: Cairo, capital do Egito

Salário bruto: 10.000 EGP/mês

Carga horária: Domingo a quinta, das 10h às 18h

Duração do intercâmbio profissional: 12 semanas (3 meses)

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Idioma exigido: Inglês avançado (idioma de trabalho da empresa)
  • Conhecimentos: Marketing digital, gerenciamento de mídias sociais e marketing de conteúdo
  • Habilidades pessoais: Criatividade, boa comunicação e visão estratégica
  • Nível mínimo de estudo: Ensino superior
  • Criar, desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar campanhas e conteúdos de marketing digital (SEO, SEM, social media, e-mail, display ads, blogs e sites).
  • Analisar métricas e relatórios de desempenho para otimizar campanhas e aumentar o ROI.
  • Monitorar e responder a comentários e avaliações online, garantindo uma imagem positiva da marca.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e diferenciação no ambiente digital.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para alinhar estratégias de marketing aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tendências e melhores práticas em marketing digital para impulsionar inovação e crescimento.

Por que fazer um intercâmbio profissional no Egito?

O Egito é um país onde tradição e modernidade se encontram. Cairo , sua capital, é um importante centro econômico e tecnológico, com baixo custo de vida e crescimento acelerado em setores como TI, marketing e inovação.

Trabalhar no Egito é uma oportunidade de desenvolver-se profissionalmente em um mercado emergente , enquanto vive uma imersão cultural única , marcada pela hospitalidade, diversidade e uma herança histórica que vai muito além das pirâmides.

Sobre a AIESEC e o programa Talento Global

O Talento Global é o programa de intercâmbio profissional da AIESEC , voltado a jovens entre 18 e 30 anos que buscam impulsionar sua carreira com experiências internacionais.

O programa conecta jovens a oportunidades de trabalho em empresas ao redor do mundo. Além da atuação profissional, você viverá uma imersão cultural e desenvolverá competências técnicas, de liderança e comunicação intercultural .

A AIESEC , presente em mais de 100 países e 6 continentes, é uma organização sem fins lucrativos, gerida por jovens e dedicada a desenvolver liderança e gerar impacto positivo no mundo .

Você receberá suporte completo da AIESEC antes, durante e após o intercâmbio, além de treinamento de liderança para potencializar sua jornada.

Benefícios oferecidos pela AIESEC

Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhão. R$ 15,4 bilhão em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhão para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

description:

description:

title: Application Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Application Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.

Job Description:

The Application Project Manager will drive the delivery and management of IT applications throughout their lifecycle. This role is essential to ensure the effectiveness, security and innovation of the applications, contributing to the overall technological advancement and operational efficiency of the organization. The professional must possess a distinct combination of business, IT, financial, and communication skills.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Project Management: Developing detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of IT projects, meeting defined goals and expectations.
  • Leadership and People Management: Lead and inspire project teams, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to team members, encouraging their professional growth.
  • Stakeholder Management: Developing and maintaining strong relationships with all project stakeholders, ensuring that their needs and expectations are understood and managed effectively.
  • Resource Management and Budget: Allocate and manage resources effectively to ensure project delivery within scope, deadline, and budget constraints. Develop and manage the project budget, seeking to optimize expenses and minimize the total cost of ownership.
  • Supplier and Contract Management: Collaborate and negotiate with suppliers, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful completion.
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance: Implement rigorous testing and quality assurance protocols. Ensure that all project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 11 to 15 years of experience. More than 10 years of experience in IT project management with a focus on application development and deployment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Tools: Proficiency in project management software such as MS Project, Jira, Trello. Knowledge of reporting and analysis tools to track metrics and project performance.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

description:
Responsibilities:

Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Quality and Engineering Specialist
description:
About us:

DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.

About the job:

The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference. They are responsible for overseeing and directing high complex quality control processes, leading strategic improvements, and ensuring the company’s adherence to industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist to oversee quality control and engineering processes for the landing gear MRO.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive quality improvement programs to enhance operational performance.
  • Technical guidance for analysts, ensuring compliance with internal procedures, manuals and best practices.
  • Perform advanced analysis of data, lead root cause investigations, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage and ensure compliance with all aerospace regulations, quality certifications (ANAC, FAA, ISO 9001, etc.) and approved technical data (CMMs and other manufacture manuals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, supply chain and planning to ensure seamless quality management.
  • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.
  • Develop and report on key quality performance indicators, identifying areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
  • Be the technical reference in strategic decision-making regarding quality and process improvements.

Work Experience:

+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).

Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.

Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.

Location:

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Organizacional Pleno

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”)..
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.

  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio

Esta é uma posição sênior, com foco em fornecer orientações especializadas de rede para o cliente. Você atuará como um consultor técnico de confiança, traduzindo necessidades complexas em soluções de alto nível que sustentam uma operação empresarial robusta e diversificada.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenho de Soluções para o Cliente: Responsável pelo design arquitetônico de projetos relacionados a redes. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento e a apresentação de soluções de rede completas, alinhadas às necessidades de uma empresa global de bens de consumo, com sedes corporativas, fábricas, centros de distribuição e lojas. O foco está na estratégia e arquitetura de alto nível — não na implementação ou configuração.
  • Suporte a RFPs e Negócios: Atuar como especialista técnico em redes durante processos de RFP (Request for Proposal), elaborando propostas técnicas detalhadas, modelos de custo e apresentando soluções para as áreas técnica e executiva do cliente.
  • Consultoria Técnica Estratégica: Ser um conselheiro técnico confiável para a LOREAL, orientando sobre estratégias de rede, seleção de tecnologias e melhores práticas. Garantir que as soluções estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de longo prazo da empresa, como transformação digital, e-commerce e otimização da cadeia de suprimentos global.
  • Conhecimento Multicamadas: Fornecer liderança arquitetônica em todas as camadas da rede — desde a Camada 1 (física), incluindo fibra óptica, até Camadas 2 e 3 (switching, roteamento e protocolos). Ter experiência com redes que suportam grandes volumes de dados, vídeo e sensores IoT é altamente desejável.
  • Colaboração Global: Trabalhar de forma eficaz com times distribuídos globalmente, garantindo execução fluida dos projetos e comunicação clara.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência: 10+ anos em engenharia e arquitetura de redes, com histórico comprovado em projetos de grande escala para clientes corporativos. Preferência para experiência nos setores de bens de consumo, varejo ou manufatura.
  • RFPs: Experiência prévia com suporte técnico em RFPs empresariais, incluindo elaboração de designs técnicos, modelos de custos e documentação de propostas.
  • Conhecimento Técnico Profundo: Compreensão avançada das camadas de rede:
  • Camada 1: Fibra óptica, DWDM;
  • Camada 2: Ethernet, switching;
  • Camada 3: Roteamento IP, BGP, OSPF.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos em linguagem clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Visão Estratégica: Experiência comprovada em cargos estratégicos e não operacionais, com foco em design de alto nível e governança.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente: Vivência anterior em posições de contato direto com o cliente, atuando como conselheiro técnico.
  • Certificações: Certificações relevantes como CCIE ou outras reconhecidas na área de arquitetura e design de redes são um diferencial.

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como
"A marca mais amada do Rio"
e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a
"Marca preferida dos Cariocas"
.

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2024, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes.

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Cumprir com as rotinas, normas e regulamentações da Instituição e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde, que sejam coerentes à função do Jovem Aprendiz.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ter no mínimo 18 anos completos.

Informações adicionais

Jacarepaguá, RJ

Horário de trabalho: 08:00 - 12:00 ou 13:00 - 17:00

Escala: segunda a sexta

Carga horária: 20 horas semanais.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Assistência médica;
